title: Karnataka public health procurement: CAG audit paras
summary: Tracks quantified CAG audit paragraphs on Karnataka public health procurement, including drugs, medicines and equipment, and checks for explicit amount linkage and dated departmental disposition.
authority: Principal Accountant General (Audit-II), Karnataka, and the Comptroller and Auditor General of India
scope: Quantified CAG audit paragraphs on drugs, medicines and medical equipment procurement.
Explicit sentence, heading or table-cell linkage between each amount and its audit observation.
Dated departmental disposition evidence and repeat audit cycles.
Pending action on audit paragraphs that remain unresolved.
out_of_scope: Private individuals, patients or clinical decisions
statutory_anchors: Articles 148–151 of the Constitution of India
Comptroller and Auditor General's (Duties, Powers and Conditions of Service) Act, 1971
